The text never addresses this. **The text's own response (if forced):** v2 uses sadaiva ("always") — the identity is perennial, so the bowing in v1 is not a transition FROM separation TO union. It is the recognition of a union that was always already the case. Executive Summary bigvisionpatala.md · 339 lines
Building Pāṭala’s philosophy engine is ambitious but tractable by **leveraging existing argumentation infrastructure** and plugging in the missing pieces. In practice, we will **own the scholarly IR and provenance layer** (propositions, commitments, frames, alignments, epistemic regimes, cruxes) and **delegate** established tasks to existing tools: structured argumentation via **ASPIC+ (py-aspic)**, abstract evaluation via **Dung frameworks (ALIAS)**, interchange via **AIF (xaif)**, and argument-mining pipelines via **oAMF** or LLM-based extractors. Key research gaps remain in *semantic alignment*, *speaker commitment extraction*, *epistemic-regime reasoning*, and *minimal crux identification*. We propose concrete data schemas, algorithms and benchmark tasks to address these. The implementation will proceed in phases: first **encode a handful of gold-standard IPVV disputes** end-to-end in our IR to validate the schema; then build adapters for py-aspic and AIF, audit inferences, and only afterward integrate LLM-based extraction. The roadmap spans ~12 months with milestones at 2–3 m…

Existing frameworks for argumentation and IR deep-research-report(10).md · 75 lines
Recent research has produced mature tools covering most of the Pāṭala pipeline. For structured reasoning, **py-aspic** is a Python library implementing the ASPIC+ framework (strict/defeasible rules, preferences, contraries). For interchange, **xAIF** provides JSON-based import/export of argument components and relations. For argument mining, the **Open Argument Mining Framework (oAMF)** offers modular, xAIF-compatible pipelines and GUI interfaces. For abstract semantics, **ALIAS** implements Dung’s AF with Python APIs for computing extensions. These projects align directly with the 12 IR objects. For example, an `InferenceApplication` in Pāṭala can be converted to a py-aspic rule (e.g. using `Rule.from_string`), or to an xAIF JSON rule node. The epistemic regime and evaluation logic can be handled by invoking ASPIC+ and ALIAS: Pāṭala’s `Argument` graphs can be fed into py-aspic (for structured reasoning) and ALIAS (for abstract acceptability) rather than reimplementing them. Static Site Generators (SSGs) and *islands*-style frameworks (Astro, Fresh/Deno, Qwik, etc.) delivered via a global CDN minimize payload and TTFB, yielding ~20–50ms response times on cache hits. For dynamic sites, **Edge SSR** (e.g. Next.js/Vercel Edge or SvelteKit on Cloudflare) brings servers close to users. For **APIs**, compiled or high-performance runtimes (Rust, Go, Bun) with HTTP/3/gRPC yield the lowest latency. Benchmarks show Bun (JSC) ~2–3× faster in raw HTTP throughput than Node/Deno, while Rust/Go (native binaries) typically handle far higher RPS under load. Binary protocols (gRPC+Protobuf) can be ~7–10× faster than JSON/REST and reduce payload size significantly. Śiva is the innermost Self of all, *“embodi[ed]…as all things, full of unbroken awareness”*. Every stage of experience is the Self knowing itself. Thus: - **Being (Stage 1):** Pure consciousness itself is fundamental. # Recognition Enquiry — Comparative Research Dossier 01 ## Central question > What, if anything, remains invariant through changing cognition, and what explanatory work does that invariant perform? This question divides into six progressively stronger contentions: 1. Is conscious occurrence intrinsically self-manifest? 2. Does self-manifestness include first-personality or ownership? 3. Does ownership persist through temporally separated experiences? 4. Does unity through change require one enduring subject? 5. Does such a subject possess genuine freedom rather than complex causal flexibility? 6. Why identify this subject with one universal consciousness? The chain must remain: [ A\not\Rightarrow B\not\Rightarrow C\not\Rightarrow D\not\Rightarrow E\not\Rightarrow F. ] No source is permitted to inherit a later conclusion merely by establishing an earlier one. --- # 1. ## Statement **Consciousness may be intrinsically self-affective manifestation rather than affectively neutral presence. A phenomenal subject is the intrinsic, self-affective manifestation of one objectively individuated process. Its field possesses relational structure that may admit mathematical representation. Local valence is not identical with bare manifestation or basal self-affection — it is modulated by field organization, regulation, expectation, embodiment, history, and context.** This is not a proof. It is the strongest hypothesis surviving critical examination of four frameworks (Tantrāloka, Tymoczko, Doczi, QRI) and a complete audit. The audit removed: golden-ratio identity, naive symmetry theory, the five-bliss/log-valence mapping, goddess-color proportions, and the claim that contemplative texts supply experimental confirmation. **This is Rasa Inexternalism — not a symmetry or golden-ratio theory of consciousness.** --- ## The Argument ### Premise 1 — Textual: Abhinavagupta characterizes consciousness as intrinsically self-relishing. **Source:** Abhinavagupta's Parātrī…
